description: [phase 3.8 38e, kind `hook defect`] showHoleStatsScreen's rating line picks its word from v / 20: `mov eax, 0x66666667; imul ebp` at 0x00453eb9..0x00453ebe and `sar edx, 3` at 0x00453ec0 (v / 10 would be `sar edx, 2`). The C4 hook source shim/src/re/c3eo.cpp computes `tier = v / 10` (its comment cites 0x00453eb9..0x00453ec8), so for v in 10..19 and 30..59 the hook appends another word than the original. The c3eo A/B and the championship scenario did not see it: the word only reaches g_textBuffer and the drawn text. Found by the 38e emulator oracle (8 of 300 cases RED until the port used v / 20). The port (holestats.cpp) follows the instructions.
path to resolution: fix c3eo.cpp (v / 20), add a c3eo vector with v in 10..19 to the registry, re-run its path-1 A/B; decide whether the row's C4 stands (re_classify.py demote / promote)
